# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c38 P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril possesses dark, dreamy eyes, endearing good looks, and a smile described as deep, black, and velvety. He is admired for his handsome physical appearance.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P40](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0040), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 c38 P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044), [v3 c38 P45](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0045)_

## Personality

Cyril is an intelligent and virtuous young man known for his constant, respectful manners and appealing voice. He is adept at offering romantic praise and displays a romantic, poetic nature. He showed great devotion when he paused his education to care for his ill mother overseas.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c38 P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044), [v3 c38 P45](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0045)_

## Goals

- Complete his Arts degree  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)</sub>
- Marry Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v3 c38 P36](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0036)</sub>

## History

Cyril completed his early college years at Wexcombe before putting his education on hold for two years to travel in Europe with his ill mother. Upon his return to Wexcombe to finish his Junior year and complete his Arts degree, he met Nell Harcourt in a park during a rainstorm when his umbrella rescued hers. He sent her a dozen long-stemmed roses with a sentimental poem and began courting her, escorting her to events such as a Wexcombe reception. Though his family visited Tabby's Place to inspect Nell as a potential bride, Cyril ultimately proposed to Nell and was turned down, leaving their relationship ended.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P41](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0041), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P44](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0044), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c36 P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 c38 P36](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0036), [v3 c38 P37](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0037)_
